properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 9 at 10:36AM EDT until September 11 at 11:00PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Tampa Bay Ruskin has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Florida...

Alafia River At Lithia affecting Hillsborough County.

Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US 301 affecting Hillsborough
County.

Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 affecting Manatee County.

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

.Heavy rainfall expected this week will bring some local rivers into
Flood Stage.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Manatee River near Myakka Head at SR 64.

* WHEN...From late tonight to Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 11.0 feet, Private road and bridge 1 mile downstream
flood. Agricultural, rural Kibler area begins to flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:15 AM EDT Wednesday the stage was 7.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 7.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage just
after midnight tonight to a crest of 11.8 feet early tomorrow
afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage Friday afternoon.
- Flood stage is 11.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 11.8
feet on 08/05/1969.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 1145 PM EDT.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 9 at 6:42PM MST until September 9 at 7:30PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
SVRTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southwestern Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 730 PM MST.

* At 642 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located near Sierra Vista,
moving west at 10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Sierra Vista, Hereford, Whetstone, Huachuca City, Fort Huachuca,
Parker Canyon Lake and Ramsey Canyon Preserve.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 between mile markers 308 and 324. Route 92 between mile
markers 322 and 331. Route 82 between mile markers 50 and 57. Route
83 between mile markers 3 and 5.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds.

Wind damage with this storm will occur before any rain or lightning.
Do not wait for the sound of thunder before taking cover. Seek
shelter immediately inside a sturdy structure and stay away from
windows.

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 9 at 9:56PM EDT until September 9 at 10:15PM EDT by NWS Pittsburgh PA
properties.description:
At 956 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 7 miles east of Byesville, or 10 miles southeast of
Cambridge, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

Locations impacted include...
Quaker City, Senecaville, Lore City, Salesville, Batesville and
Seneca Lake Park.
properties.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

properties.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 945 PM MST.

* At 652 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain in the Whetstone and Fairbank area. Between 1 and 2
inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Whetstone, Huachuca City, Fairbank and Charleston.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 between mile markers 300 and 313. Route 80 between mile
markers 306 and 313. Route 82 between mile markers 49 and 67.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Slaughter House Wash, Middle Canyon Wash, Babocomari River,
Escalante Wash, San Pedro River, Walnut Gulch, Willow Wash and
Clifford Wash.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
